name: gallery-modal-accordion

frames.best_why: Frame 5 shows one photo opened large over the blurred strip; the rest are hover previews of the closed accordion.

tagline: Slivers of photos widen under the cursor and open into a big square.
summary: A row of thin photo strips that widen on hover and open one image large over a blurred page. A title and short description sit in a strip at the foot of the opened photo.
appearance: A horizontal row of narrow vertical image slivers with rounded corners; one sliver widens into a tall rectangle under the cursor. Opened, a single square photo floats over a blurred, darkened copy of the row, with a small caption strip at its base.
behaviour: Sliding across the row widens whichever sliver is under the pointer; clicking it opens that photo as a centered square while the row behind blurs and dims. Clicking the backdrop or pressing Escape closes it.
demo_content: Eleven mountain and nature photos with titles such as Misty Mountain Majesty and Winter Wonderland
search_phrases: photo strips that widen on hover
click a picture to see it larger
image lightbox over a blurred page
gallery images that grow and open
use_when: A portfolio needs many images in little space but still wants a big single view.
avoid_when: Only slivers show at rest, so images are hard to judge without hovering each one.
customise: itemsArr holds each image URL, title, description and tags; sliver widths and overlay blur live in the file.
weight_why: Eleven remote photos with width animation and a full-screen blurred overlay.

a11y.note: Photos are click-only images with no alt; Escape closes the overlay but nothing on the strip can be tabbed to.

issues: Strip images have no alt text; only the opened photo gets a generic alt.
The caption over the opened photo is faint and hard to read.
polish_why: Distinctive hover accordion and modal reveal; faint captions and no alt text cost a point.
